$comment: HR8 upstream-core overlay gate (zettlab-product-dev 总方案 §1.3 / 附录 H). `protected` = Hermes upstream core files that must track NousResearch upstream; every hunk that adds lines there must carry a `zettlab-overlay(<batch>): <one line>; upstream: <PR url | #n | none>` marker, the whole PR may add at most `added_lines_budget` lines to protected files, and the PR body must carry an `upstream-pr:` line. `exempt` = the fork-owned adapter layer only (gateway/platforms/zet_agent*.py, ui_map/**, tests/**); no wildcard exemptions inside agent/** or tools/** — Zettlab state must live in the adapter, not in a new kernel file.
